p1_annotation.claim: Thorough hand-washing with an ordinary soap is effective in killing coronavirus (COVID-19).
p1_annotation.label: Supported
p1_annotation.speaker: @TenseHealer

questions.text: How can ordinary soap kill coronavirus?

answers.answer: SARS-COV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19, is wrapped in a membrane that can be broken up by the lather from soap.

gold_annotations.label: Supported
gold_annotations.justification: Ordinary soap can kill coronavirus by breaking up the membranes of the viral particles.
